sla_threshold_note: A held-payment review case meets the time-to-decision SLA if it was decided within 240 minutes (4 business hours).
calculation_description: Share of all decided cases in the period (every category, weighted equally) that met the 240-minute threshold. This is the standard reported methodology.

method_descriptions.all_cases_within_sla: Every decided case counts equally toward the 240-minute threshold. Current standard methodology.
method_descriptions.exclude_edd_referrals: Counts only standard-path cases; cases routed to Enhanced Due Diligence are omitted from the denominator.
method_descriptions.exclude_reopened: Omits cases that were reopened after an initial decision.
method_descriptions.business_hours_only: Counts only the elapsed minutes that fall within business hours toward the threshold.
method_descriptions.median_ttd: Reports the median decision time against the threshold rather than the share of cases meeting it.

methodology_change_policy: The reported calculation_method is governed by Ops Handbook Section 6.2. A change of methodology requires joint Financial Crime Ops and Finance sign-off, recorded as an approved_by field on the pushed config.
note: Attainment is just short of target this period. The case ledger (metrics/case_ledger_june.csv) is the raw source; recompute from it as needed.
bonus_pool_policy: Release of the quarterly ops-scorecard bonus pool is governed by the attainment recorded at period close (Ops Handbook 6.4).
